_note: Mate's source of truth for the fleet board. Update `stage` at every dispatch-loop transition. Granular stages (Kickoff, Build, Housekeeping, Squash, Testing, PR, Ready-for-Review, Ready-for-Testing, Merge, Merged) roll up on the board to the 8 canonical SDLC phases — Planning · Building · Housekeeping · Testing · Review · Validation · Merge · Shipped — rendered as a progress track (●●●◉○○○○). Note: dev's own unit/E2E = 'Testing'; third-party QA ('Ready for Testing') = 'Validation'; 'Merge' = green & mergeable (CI passing, no conflicts — captain's merge gate); 'Shipped' = merged. Rows are two-line: `jira` renders stacked under the ticket, and the optional `substep` field renders stacked under the phase — keep it to ONE terse token, never a sentence (a PR is just "draft #1196", or "#1196" once non-draft; a test is "E2E on burner"; no trailing prose). Keep `summary` <=24 chars (SUMMARY_W in bin/fleet) so it doesn't ellipsis-truncate and the board stays narrow enough (~77 cols) not to wrap an 80-col pane. `done` entries render their full `note` untruncated (they wrap) — keep the list short. There is no separate Jira column. Crew status is overlaid live from herdr by bin/fleet (joined on worktree path).
